items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Ordering is simple: choose a bundle, add it to your cart and follow the steps at checkout. Enter your delivery details, pick a shipping method and pay. You'll get an email confirming your order, and we'll send a tracking number as soon as your parcel is on its way.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Payments are processed by Stripe. We accept Visa, Mastercard, Maestro and American Express cards, as well as Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut Pay and PayPal. Your card details never pass through our servers.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Standard delivery within Croatia usually takes 3–5 business days; express and parcel locker delivery take 1–2 business days. Orders placed by 2:00 PM on a business day ship the same day. Exact times for each method are on our Shipping page.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: The shipping cost depends on the method you choose and is always shown at checkout before you pay. For orders over €50, standard delivery and parcel locker pickup are free. All prices are listed on our Shipping page.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: We currently deliver throughout Croatia, including the islands. Delivery to other countries isn't available yet — subscribe to our newsletter and we'll let you know when that changes.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You have a legal right to withdraw from the purchase within 14 days of receiving your parcel, without giving a reason. On top of that, we offer a voluntary 30-day return or exchange for unused products in their original packaging. We refund you within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal notice. Return shipping is paid by you unless the mistake was ours. Full details are in our Terms of Sale.

items.question: How do I return a product?
items.answer: Email us at {email} or call {phone} and include your order number. You can use the withdrawal form in our Terms of Sale, but you don't have to. We'll send you the return address. Pack the product, ideally in its original packaging, and send it no later than 14 days after your withdrawal notice. We'll let you know once your return has been processed.

items.question: Can I customize the bundle contents?
items.answer: We currently offer ready-made bundles for feeding, bath time and sleep. If you have special requests, get in touch and we'll do our best to find a solution for you.

shippingPage.title: Shipping Information
shippingPage.intro: We want your parcel to arrive quickly, safely and undamaged. Here are all our shipping methods, delivery times and prices.

freeShipping.description: For orders over {amount} within Croatia, shipping is free for: {methods}. The discount is applied automatically at checkout — no promo code needed.

deliveryAreas.title: Delivery Areas
deliveryAreas.description: We deliver throughout the Republic of Croatia, including the islands. Delivery to the islands may take 1–2 business days longer than stated. For island addresses we recommend standard delivery, as express delivery is limited to the mainland.
deliveryAreas.international: Delivery to other countries isn't available yet. Subscribe to our newsletter and we'll let you know when that changes.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.description: We pack every order with care so it arrives undamaged. Our boxes are designed so the bundle is ready to give as a gift, with no extra wrapping needed.

tracking.title: Shipment Tracking
tracking.description: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can also check your order status on our Track Order page.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: We want you to be completely happy with your purchase. That's why, on top of your legal 14-day right of withdrawal, we offer a voluntary 30-day return or exchange. The voluntary period is in addition to your legal right and doesn't limit it in any way.

legal.title: Your legal right of withdrawal (14 days)
legal.description: You can withdraw from the contract without giving a reason within 14 days of receiving your parcel. You may open and examine the product as far as needed to establish its nature, characteristics and functioning. We refund your money, including the standard delivery cost, no later than 14 days after receiving your withdrawal notice.
legal.link: Full details and the withdrawal form are in our <link>Terms of Sale</link>.

conditions.title: Voluntary return conditions (up to 30 days)
conditions.note: These conditions apply to returns after the legal 14-day period. During the first 14 days, the legal rules above apply.
items: Tell us about the return within 30 days of receiving your order.
The product must be unused and in its original packaging.
All original tags and labels must be intact.
The product must not have been washed, worn or used in any way.
Include your order number or receipt with the return.

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.description: Email us at {email} or call {phone} and include your order number. For a legal withdrawal you can use the form in our Terms of Sale, but you don't have to.

steps.title: Receive instructions
steps.description: We'll reply with a confirmation and the address to send the product to.

steps.title: Ship the package
steps.description: Pack the product, ideally in its original packaging, and send it no later than 14 days after contacting us.

steps.title: Refund
steps.description: Once we've received and checked the product, we refund you and confirm by email.

refund.title: Refunds
refund.description: We refund you without undue delay and no later than 14 days after receiving your withdrawal notice, using the same payment method you used for the purchase. We may hold the refund until we've received the product or proof that you've sent it. For card payments, your bank may need a few more business days before the amount shows in your account.
refund.shippingCosts: If you withdraw within the legal 14-day period, we also refund the cost of delivery to you, up to the price of our cheapest standard delivery. For voluntary returns after 14 days, delivery costs aren't refunded. Return shipping is paid by you unless the mistake was ours (wrong, damaged or faulty product) — in that case we cover all costs.

exchange.title: Exchanges
exchange.description: If you'd like to swap your bundle for a different one, get in touch and we'll be happy to help. We cover the cost of sending the replacement, and ship it within 1–2 business days of receiving your return.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: For health and hygiene reasons, the right of withdrawal does not apply to sealed products whose protective seal was opened after delivery, if this makes them unsuitable for return. This exception does not affect your rights if a product is faulty.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: At LunaBaby, we take the protection of your personal data seriously. This privacy policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and what your rights are. Please read this policy carefully.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.description: We only collect data that is necessary for providing our services. This includes:
items: Personal data: name, surname, email address, phone number, and delivery address that you provide when placing an order.
Order data: information about purchased products, amounts, payment methods, and order status.
Communication data: messages you send us via the contact form, email, or phone.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, operating system, and interaction data with our website collected automatically.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Our website uses cookies to improve your experience. We use:
items: Essential cookies: needed for the site to work, including the cart and sign-in. They cannot be switched off.
Analytics cookies: help us understand how you use the site so we can improve it. We only set them with your consent.
Functional cookies: remember your settings, such as language.
cookies.note: We do not use advertising cookies or share data with advertising networks. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.description: We use your data exclusively for the following purposes:
items: Processing and delivering your orders.
Communication related to your orders (confirmations, shipping notifications, responses to enquiries).
Improving our website and user experience based on anonymised analytics data.
Sending newsletters and promotional offers, only with your explicit consent.
Fulfilling legal obligations (accounting, tax records).

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.description: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We only share data with:
items: Courier services: name, address, and phone number for delivery purposes.
Stripe (payment processor): the data needed to process your payment securely. We don't store your card details.
Hosting and IT services: trusted service providers who are contractually bound to protect your data.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.description: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected. Order data is retained for 5 years in accordance with legal obligations. Newsletter data is retained until you unsubscribe. After expiry, data is securely deleted or anonymised.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.description: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
items: Right of access: you can request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
Right to rectification: you can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to erasure: you can request deletion of your personal data ('right to be forgotten').
Right to restriction of processing: you can request restriction of how we use your data.
Right to data portability: you can request transfer of your data in a structured format.
Right to object: you can object to the processing of your data for marketing purposes.

contact.title: Data Protection Contact
contact.description: For all questions regarding the protection of your personal data, please contact us at:
contact.note: We'll reply to your request within one month at the latest, as required by the GDPR. If you believe your rights have not been respected, you can lodge a complaint with the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP).

terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.intro: These terms apply to all purchases from the LunaBaby online shop (lunababy.eu). By placing an order you confirm that you have read and accept them. How we process your personal data is described in our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

seller.title: Seller
seller.intro: The seller at the lunababy.eu online shop is:

ordering.title: Ordering and the contract
paragraphs: Choose products in the shop and add them to your cart. At checkout you enter your contact and delivery details, choose a shipping method and see the total including shipping before you pay.

Before placing the order you can check and correct everything you entered. The contract is concluded when you place the order and your payment succeeds. We email you an order confirmation with all the details.
If a product turns out to be unavailable after you've ordered, we'll let you know straight away and refund the amount you paid.

prices.title: Prices
paragraphs: All prices are in euros (EUR) and are final. Shipping is not included in product prices; it is shown at checkout before you pay.
When a price is reduced, we also show the lowest price of the product in the 30 days before the reduction.
Prices may change. Your order is charged at the price shown when you placed it.

payment.title: Payment
paragraphs: You pay online when you order. Payments are processed by Stripe, a licensed payment service provider. You can pay by card (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, American Express), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut Pay or PayPal. Which methods are available may depend on your device and browser.
You enter your card details directly on Stripe's secure page. They never pass through our servers and we don't store them.
Your payment is taken when you pay. If we can't deliver your order, we refund the full amount to the same payment method.

delivery.title: Delivery
paragraphs: We deliver to addresses in the Republic of Croatia. Shipping methods, prices and expected delivery times are listed on our <shipping>Shipping</shipping> page and at checkout.
The risk of loss or damage passes to you when you, or a person you name, receive the parcel.
Please check the packaging when you receive it. If it is damaged, tell the courier and contact us as soon as possible.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
paragraphs: As a consumer, you have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving any reason, under the Croatian Consumer Protection Act and Directive 2011/83/EU. The period starts on the day you, or a person you name (other than the carrier), receive the goods. If your order arrives in several parcels, it starts when you receive the last one.

To withdraw, send us a clear statement, for example by email to <mail>{email}</mail>. You can use the form below, but you don't have to. You meet the deadline if you send your statement before it expires.

After you withdraw, we refund everything you paid, including the cost of delivery to you (except any extra cost if you chose a delivery method more expensive than our cheapest standard delivery), without undue delay and no later than 14 days after we receive your statement. We use the same payment method you used, unless we expressly agree otherwise, and we don't charge any fee for the refund. We may hold the refund until we've received the goods or proof that you've sent them, whichever comes first.

Send the goods back without undue delay and no later than 14 days after you sent us your withdrawal statement. You pay the direct cost of returning the goods. You are only liable for any loss in value caused by handling beyond what was needed to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning.
The right of withdrawal does not apply to sealed goods that are not suitable for return for health protection or hygiene reasons if they were unsealed after delivery.

goodwill.title: Voluntary 30-day returns
goodwill.text: In addition to your legal right, we offer a voluntary 30-day period from delivery to return or exchange unused goods in their original packaging. It extends your legal right and doesn't replace it: during the first 14 days, the legal rules above always apply. Conditions and the process are described on our <returns>Returns</returns> page.

form.title: Model withdrawal form
form.intro: Fill in and send this form only if you want to withdraw from the contract. You can copy the text and paste it into an email.
lines: I/We (*) hereby give notice that I/We (*) withdraw from my/our (*) contract of sale of the following goods:
Signature of consumer(s) (only if this form is sent on paper):

warranty.title: Liability for defects and guarantees
paragraphs: We are liable for material defects in the goods under the Croatian Civil Obligations Act, for defects that appear within two years of delivery. If you notice a defect, please tell us as soon as possible and no later than two months after you discover it.

If a product is faulty, you can ask for it to be repaired or replaced, for a price reduction, or to cancel the contract and get your money back, as provided by law. In that case we cover the cost of the return.
Where a manufacturer offers a guarantee, it applies in addition to our legal liability and doesn't limit it.

complaints.title: Written complaints
complaints.email: You can send us a written complaint by email to <mail>{email}</mail>.
complaints.post: You can also send a complaint by post to: {address}.
complaints.response: We'll confirm receipt of your complaint without delay and send you a written reply within 15 days of receiving it, as required by the Croatian Consumer Protection Act.

disputes.title: Out-of-court dispute resolution
paragraphs: We try to resolve any dispute amicably. If we can't, you can turn to a body for out-of-court resolution of consumer disputes. The list of these bodies in Croatia is published by the ministry responsible for consumer protection.
You always have the right to report the matter to the State Inspectorate (Državni inspektorat) or to bring a claim before the competent court.
disputes.odr: You can also submit a dispute through the EU online dispute resolution platform: <odr>{url}</odr>.

law.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms and contracts concluded in our shop are governed by Croatian law. This does not take away the protection given to you by the mandatory provisions of the law of the country where you normally live.
